definitions.explanation: The two opposite ends of something, whether physical (a rope, bridge, table) or abstract (a spectrum, range).

examples.japanese: ⟦ロープ→ロープ：27860_roopu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{両端|りょうたん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧。
examples.english: Hold both ends of the rope.

examples.japanese: ⟦テーブル→テーブル：04488_teeburu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{両端|りょうたん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飾|かざ}った→飾る：01185_kazaru⟧。
examples.english: I placed flowers at both ends of the table.

examples.japanese: ⟦{橋|はし}→橋：02163_hashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{両端|りょうたん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{警備員|けいびいん}→警備員：09867_keibiin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{立|た}っていた→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧。
examples.english: Security guards were standing at both ends of the bridge.

notes:
The two opposite ends of something, whether physical or abstract.

FORMS:
⟦{両|りょう}→両：11182_ryou⟧ (both) + {端|たん} (end/edge)

PRONUNCIATION:
The standard reading is りょうたん. The reading りょうはし is also heard in casual speech.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {両端|りょうたん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧: to hold both ends
- {両端|りょうたん}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧: from both ends
- {両端|りょうたん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: at both ends
- {両端|りょうたん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧: to cut both ends

RELATED WORDS:
- {片端|かたはし}: one end
- ⟦{先端|せんたん}→先端：04370_sentan⟧: tip, cutting edge
- ⟦{端|はし}→端：00936_hashi⟧/{端|はた}: edge, end

Used for physical objects (ropes, bridges, tables, corridors) and abstractly for extremes of a range or spectrum.
